findings.evidence: Separate common-name top-level import packages can be shadowed by target projects or dependencies.
findings.required_change: Map repository responsibility roots into one collision-resistant distribution-owned namespace and make CLI import the installed distribution.
findings.verification: Wheel inspection and decoy-package tests inside and outside the repository.

findings.evidence: A wheel does not consume uv.lock and the install contract did not bind exact artifacts, interpreter, trusted sources, hashes or supply-chain evidence.
findings.required_change: Define a reproducible release bundle/install contract with exact verified inputs and fail-closed unsupported cases.
findings.verification: Repeated clean macOS/Linux installs match; tampered or incompatible inputs fail before execution.

findings.evidence: Skill installation, executable resolution, PATH shadowing and cross-component compatibility handshake were unspecified.
findings.required_change: Define runtime-specific Skill ownership, canonical locator, version source and pre-mutation compatibility handshake.
findings.verification: Clean installs resolve the intended executable and reject shadowed or incompatible components.

findings.evidence: Packaging upgrade rollback and failed state-migration recovery were not defined.
findings.required_change: Define staged upgrade/cutover/rollback retaining the prior executable and state.
findings.verification: Failure injection at install, doctor, migration and cutover preserves the prior usable version.
